metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: Since the kids loved the sequel, they will adore the original movie that introduced Riley's colorful and funny emotions.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: They watched Frozen II, so they must see the origin of Elsa and Anna's magical sisterly bond and the iconic songs.

metas.name: Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: A Pixar masterpiece that combines clever comedy and heartwarming friendships, perfect for fans of Toy Story.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A delightful, sun-soaked adventure about friendship and staying true to yourself, matching the charm of Turning Red.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: An epic, beautifully animated fantasy adventure featuring a strong bond between a boy and his dragon, perfect for fans of Raya.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: Features exciting superhero action, hilarious moments, and the lovable robot Baymax, appealing to fans of Sonic and Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: A highly creative video-game adventure with plenty of humor and heart, ideal for kids who enjoyed The Super Mario Bros. Movie.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: Since they enjoyed Studio Ghibli films and The Borrowers, this beautiful adaptation about tiny people is a perfect match.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A hilariously chaotic family road trip movie with a vibrant animation style similar to Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: An incredibly heartwarming, funny, and beautifully crafted family film that delivers pure joy for kids and parents alike.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: Continuing the fun of the first Despicable Me with even more hilarious Minion antics and heartwarming family dynamics.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: A thrilling and incredibly funny superhero family adventure that fans of action packed movies like Spider-Verse will love.

metas.name: Moana 2
metas.description: Since they loved the original ocean adventure, this exciting sequel brings back Moana and Maui for another voyage.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: An imaginative and emotional Pixar adventure about a floating house, a loyal dog, and an adventurous wilderness explorer.

metas.name: Lilo & Stitch
metas.description: A hilarious and touchingly sweet story about family, sisterhood, and a mischievous alien experiment who loves Elvis.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: Completes the trilogy of the kids' favorite dragon warrior as Po reunites with his biological father and learns to master his Chi.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: A magical, modern fantasy quest about two elf brothers, full of humor and heart, matching their love for adventure films.

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: The legendary classic that inspired Lion King II and Mufasa, filled with unforgettable characters and timeless songs.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A brilliant supervillain comedy that subverts hero tropes, matching the villain-protagonist style of Despicable Me and The Bad Guys.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A fast-paced, highly energetic monster comedy that is silly, spooky, and sweet without being scary.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: An incredibly wacky, fast-paced comedy about food falling from the sky that will keep kids laughing from start to finish.

metas.name: Elemental
metas.description: A beautiful, clever Pixar story set in Element City, focusing on family expectations and connection, similar to Inside Out.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A magical and breathtaking journey to return a cute Yeti to his home, appealing to fans of Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: A hilarious prehistoric road-trip adventure about a family discovering a vibrant, fantastical new world.

metas.name: Minions: The Rise of Gru
metas.description: A laugh-out-loud prequel showing how young Gru teamed up with his yellow companions, perfect for Despicable Me fans.

metas.name: Shaun the Sheep Movie
metas.description: A brilliant silent comedy from the creators of Chicken Run and Wallace & Gromit, packed with clever visual humor.

metas.name: Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget
metas.description: Since they enjoyed the 2000 classic, this modern sequel offers more fun claymation heist antics with Ginger and Rocky.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: Introduces the adorable, polite bear from Peru who gets into charmingly funny mishaps in London.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: A fun and chaotic look at what pets do when their owners leave, capturing the animal humor of Zootopia.

metas.name: Wish Dragon
metas.description: A heartwarming and funny modern-day magical adventure about friendship, similar in style to Aladdin.

metas.name: The Cat Returns
metas.description: A whimsical, lighthearted Studio Ghibli fantasy about a girl who travels to a magical kingdom of talking cats.

metas.name: Aladdin
metas.description: A high-flying Disney musical masterpiece with a magical genie, thrilling action, and great songs.

metas.name: A Bug's Life
metas.description: A classic Pixar film about a clever ant who recruits a band of circus bugs to save his colony.

metas.name: The Princess and the Frog
metas.description: A jazz-infused fairy tale with brilliant animation, incredible music, and charming swamp companions.

metas.name: Trolls
metas.description: A vibrant, music-filled, feel-good animated adventure featuring colorful characters and catchy pop tracks like Sing.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: A fun adventure about a TV star dog who thinks he has real superpowers, perfect for animal and action movie fans.

metas.name: Orion and the Dark
metas.description: A clever, warm animated film about conquering fears and making friends with the dark, great for fans of Inside Out.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: A charming and highly funny musical comedy about a sweet classroom lizard helping kids navigate their problems.

metas.name: The Wild Robot
metas.description: A stunningly beautiful and emotional adventure about a shipwrecked robot adopting an orphaned gosling in the wilderness.
